data.summary: The independent validation report for CR-001 (CR-001 Retail PD Scorecard) has concluded with an overall rating of Not fit for use. Key findings include Favourable-outcome parity across groups (disparate impact) — `age_band` with a status of amber, Share of adverse decisions with a status of amber, and Monotonicity of score with respect to bad rate with a status of red. Other metrics such as Discrimination (Gini) on oot, Calibration (predicted ÷ observed), and Input stability train → oot (CSI) for various factors have passed. The report highlights the need for re-validation on recent live traffic due to the identified issues.
